# About keeping research and decisions apart

A decision is easier to find and to revisit when its research lives elsewhere.[^diataxis]

## 1. Decision

Each recorded choice gets its own document.

## 2. Sources

Inline code such as `[^not-a-footnote]` and fenced blocks are ignored:

```markdown
Example.[^example]
```

[^diataxis]: [Diátaxis](https://diataxis.fr): one job per document.
